dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the bounty target...

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: This is "Crackjaw" Hark. Several months ago, he was spotted near the Nothing Passage, but there haven't been any sightings since. He might've gone into hiding, we think.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Honestly... We don't have much hope of bringing him to justice unless we have more information.
